archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm) with Modern SaaS Polish
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements and key informational elements include testids like data-testid='seller-login-btn', data-testid='stock-update-input', data-testid='customer-select', etc.
Implement phone OTP seller login flow with simulated OTP verification.
Stock management: allow adding/editing products with price, stock count, availability toggle, and category.
Customer detail management: name, phone, address, and fixed society dropdown (e.g. Prestige Ozone, Palm Meadows, Brigade Gateway, Sobha Dream Acres, Godrej Woods).

Customer order placement: select customer from society, add products with quantities, calculate totals, place order, update delivery status (Pending, Out for Delivery, Delivered), and view order history.
Ensure all UI components use Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui primitives, and lucide-react icons.
Make the UI extremely attractive, featuring clean bento cards, badge tags for delivery status, quick action buttons, and responsive tables/grids.
